question: Where is the closest emergency hospital close by Ulrich Wildlife Preserve, Morton, IL?
sql: SELECT P.poi_name FROM pois AS P WHERE P.emergency = TRUE AND P.amenity = 'hospital' ORDER BY ST_Distance(P.geometry::geography, ( SELECT PA.geometry::geography FROM parks AS PA WHERE PA.park_name ILIKE '%Ulrich Wildlife Preserve%' AND ST_Intersects(PA.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry::geography FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Morton%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1 )) ASC LIMIT 1;
